incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency breach on /v1/generate (redwood/gpt-3l-int8-v2) — streaming stalls observed, customer error rate elevated. Paging oncall Priya Nair :rotating_light:
Priya Nair: got it, I'm oncall. pulling metrics now. which region?
incident-bot: Affected region: us-west-2. Rolling 1m p95=420ms (normal ~120ms), p99=1.8s. Streaming stall rate 0.9% -> 6.7%.
Priya Nair: thanks. tagging eng-ml and runtime. Ben / Samir can you join?
Ben Chu: joining. I see a coincident config push at 02:13 UTC: applied new precision profile for int8 calibration to reduce memory. Hash: a1f9c3.
Samir Patel: I'm looking at the canary dashboard — canary to prod moved at 02:12, slow increase in latency around 02:15. streaming stall traces show repeated 'kv cache miss + recompile' events.
Alice Ramos: CS ping — we have a few customers reporting partial streaming timeouts. One support ticket: "responses hang > 10s" on large-context chat.
Priya Nair: immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable int8 calibration profile to force fallback to fp16 variant 2) enable routing to fallback model shard 3) drain long-lived streams if necessary. Who can flip the profile?
Samir Patel: I can flip the profile on control plane. Will rollback calibration flag for the model to "fp16-preferred". Doing a staged change to avoid mass restarts.
deploy-bot: DEPLOYMENT: change requested by Samir Patel — rolled to 10% traffic at 02:27 UTC.
Ben Chu: logs from runtime nodes show CPU spike during per-token dequantize path after the calibration change. Also see increased GC pauses in helper process that manages KV indexing.
Marco Li: checking kernel selection logs — int8 path triggered a fallback to per-layer dequantization for long contexts. That path isn't optimized for streaming so stalls appear at tail. Patch note: quant-profile didn't include a long-context fast-path.
Priya Nair: Samir, can you bump to 50% and monitor p99? We want to confirm rollback improves tail.
Samir Patel: bumping to 50% now.
Priya Nair: metrics after 5m: p95=140ms, p99=310ms, streaming stall rate down to 1.1%. Positive so far.
Ben Chu: confirm: error rate dropped, but a small subset of sessions still see stalls — likely sessions pinned to older nodes with warm KV caches in int8 mode.
Alice Ramos: CS-Liaison: please prepare a short customer note: "We mitigated increased latency by reverting a precision calibration change; investigating root cause and will follow up." Any high-visibility customers impacted?
CS-Liaison: Noting two enterprise customers with degraded UX; support already opened SEV tickets. Will prepare hold message.
Samir Patel: increasing to 100% rollback at 02:42 UTC. deploy-bot: DEPLOYMENT: rollback to fp16-preferred at 100% by Samir Patel — completed 02:42 UTC.
deploy-bot: DEPLOYMENT: affected nodes restarted gracefully (rolling restart) 02:44-02:46 UTC.
Priya Nair: monitoring: p99 steady ~280-350ms now, streaming stalls ~0.4%. Good. Marking live mitigation successful.
Ben Chu: quick root-cause notes while fresh: the new int8 precision profile enabled an experimental per-layer dequantization that didn't have the streaming KV hot-path optimized. For long-context requests, the runtime hit a dequantization hotspot that blocked the streaming event loop leading to tail stalls. Also calibration step mutated KV layout causing increased cache churn.
Marco Li: reproducer steps: run a long-context stream with batch size 1 and prefix tokens ~1500 using int8-profile a1f9c3; observe token emission pauses at ~1.2k tokens and occasional recompile logs: 
``` 
[runtime] dequant_layer: block_time=120ms layer=35
[kv-cache] eviction=high rehash=true
``` 
Priya Nair: next actions before we close incident: 1) eng-ml to embargo int8-profile a1f9c3 and add longer canary with long-context load tests 2) runtime to add streaming fast-path for int8 dequant or prevent that profile on streams 3) ops to add a guardrail in rotation to avoid calibrations without long-context validation 4) CS to notify impacted customers with timeline and mitigation done.
Samir Patel: creating a rollback-only hotfix branch and adding a test to the calibration pipeline to run a 2k-token streaming workload. Will open PR and link in this thread.
Ben Chu: I'll instrument KV cache metrics per-profile and add alerting if eviction_rate jumps >2x baseline.
Alice Ramos: CS-Liaison prepared customer note draft, sending to Priya for ok.
CS-Liaison: draft: "We've reverted a precision calibration change that caused increased latency for some streaming workloads. We've applied a rollback and rolled out a fix; engineering is investigating a full root cause. We will provide a detailed postmortem and timeline by EOD."
Priya Nair: looks good, please send to affected accounts and mark SEV tickets with mitigation details.
Priya Nair: closing live paging now but keeping incident thread open for postmortem items. Thank you everyone for fast response. :tada:
Samir Patel: created PR #4821 (hotfix + long-context test) — link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/precision-configs/pulls/4821
Ben Chu: added KV eviction alert runbook entry: /runbooks/runtime/kv-eviction.md
Marco Li: filing follow-up to add optimized dequant streaming path — ENG-ML ticket #ML-1098.
Alice Ramos: logging for SLA reporting — please export p95/p99 graphs for affected 02:10-03:00 UTC window and drop in the incident doc.
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: live mitigation=rollback precision profile -> fp16-preferred, status=resolved (latency returned to normal), followups recorded.
Priya Nair: assigning postmortem owner Samir Patel; due in 48h. I'll create incident doc skeleton in the incidents repo.
